directAnswer.en: This is a pipe trench or a short pipeline placement. The printed window is vertical 15–20 m and horizontal 60–80 m, with aggregate 1–3 cm. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Electric 15 at 15 kW, 8–10 m³/h, vertical 15–20 m, horizontal 60–80 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, pipe 100–125 mm, 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm and 450 kg. Do not move the same condition onto Electric 10 Series, which prints 15 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, horizontal 25 m, aggregate 2 cm and below, hopper 0.1 m³, 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm and 400 kg. The page does not print a vertical distance. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
directAnswer.zh: 这是管沟或一段较短的管道浇筑。已印窗口是垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m，骨料 1–3 cm。邢台河北品锦机械把电动15列为15 kW、8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、骨料 1–3 cm、管内径 100–125 mm、外形 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm、450 kg。不要把同一工况挪到电动10系列，那一行印的是15 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、水平 25 m、骨料 2 cm 及以下、料斗 0.1 m³、外形 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm、400 kg。这一页没有印垂直距离。这张照片来自一篇公开文章，只作这类工况的参照。它不是品锦的合同记录。本页不写项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。

body.en: Send the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical line you measured, and the supply the printed motor needs. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job, a price or a daily volume.
body.zh: 请发送配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及已印电机需要的电源。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。
